summary: Frontend regression testing after aggressive dead-code cleanup (deletion of ~41/43 shadcn ui components, ~40 npm packages, hooks/use-toast, and 2 backend helpers). Full end-to-end web flow was exercised: Landing → Register (2-step) → Login → Feed → Compose post → Delete post with AlertDialog confirmation → navigation across all protected pages. ALL PASSED. No 'Module not found', no runtime page errors, no broken UI. The one retained shadcn component (alert-dialog.jsx) still renders and works correctly in PostCard's delete confirmation. Sonner toasts render correctly ('Deleted' toast confirmed on post deletion). Backend /health returns 200 on the preview URL. APK / Google Sign-In on native mobile was NOT tested (no device/emulator, out of scope).

minor.issue: GET /api/health returns 404 (only unprefixed /health at 200). Not a regression — the review request said the /health endpoint is intentionally at root for k8s readiness probe. Just noting that clients that expect /api/health won't find it.

verifications_performed.grep_stale_imports: grep across frontend/src for imports from components/ui/*, hooks/use-toast, date-fns, dayjs, react-day-picker, react-hook-form, @hookform, zod, framer-motion, lodash, recharts, swr, cmdk, next-themes, vaul, embla-carousel, input-otp -> ONLY 1 match: components/ui/alert-dialog.jsx importing components/ui/button — both kept files, no stale references remain.
verifications_performed.public_pages_load: /, /login, /register, /forgot-password, /install all render (title 'ClanChat — Your Personal Clubhouse', no page errors).
verifications_performed.protected_pages_redirect: /feed, /messages, /me, /settings, /notifications, /search, /groups, /connections, /admin all correctly redirect to /login when unauthed; no module-not-found console errors.
verifications_performed.register_step1_to_step2: Email+password → Continue → Step 2 renders handle, display name, DOB (native date input).
verifications_performed.register_creates_account: Create account → auto-signs-in → redirected to /feed with sidebar populated (handle #tu1787093291, display name 'Test User').
verifications_performed.login_flow_reauth: Logout+re-login with the created creds succeeds, lands on /feed.
verifications_performed.protected_pages_authed_load: /feed, /messages, /me, /settings, /notifications, /search, /groups, /connections all render with content while authed (body lengths 162–1758 chars, sidebar visible everywhere).
verifications_performed.compose_post: /compose renders with all fields (post-content, upload-input, tag-input, tier buttons, AI labels, submit-post). Submitting creates the post; feed shows it with data-testid post_XXXX.
verifications_performed.alertdialog_delete_confirmation: PASSED — Clicking [data-testid=del-btn-post_*] opens a role=alertdialog containing 'Delete this post? This cannot be undone.' with [data-testid=confirm-cancel] and [data-testid=confirm-delete]. Clicking confirm-delete removes the post from feed and shows a sonner 'Deleted' toast.
verifications_performed.sonner_toasts_work: 'Deleted' toast rendered on post deletion (visible in screenshot), confirming Toaster from 'sonner' still works after the removal of components/ui/toast.jsx and hooks/use-toast.js.
verifications_performed.console_errors_review: Only 401 responses observed (expected on unauthed API polls for notifications/feed); zero 'Module not found', zero uncaught page errors.

critical_code_review_comments: The dead-code deletion is clean — a repo-wide grep confirms no source file still references any of the removed packages/components/hooks except the two retained shadcn files (alert-dialog + button), which correctly reference each other. No orphan imports.

Minor (pre-existing, not caused by this cleanup): App.js renders <Toaster theme='dark' …/> at the root AND useOAuthReturn() imports getSupabase both statically (line 5) and dynamically (line 93) in the same file — cosmetic only.
Observation: onboarding modal ('Three tiers. One simple rule.') pops on first login and can obscure the feed until Skip is pressed. Not a regression; noting for UX awareness.

APK / native Google Sign-In cannot be verified inside this sandbox — that must be validated by the user on a real device against the production Render deployment (which is now believed healthy after JWT_SECRET + /health fixes).
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions found. The user's reported 'APK network error' bug is very likely explained by the backend crash-loop (missing JWT_SECRET) on the production Render deployment, as the review request already hypothesized; that is a deployment-env issue outside sandbox testability.
